findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：歐盟 IFR 對消費信用/金融卡跨境與境內交換費設 30/20 bps 有效上限，歐盟執委會宣布將再做影響評估，可能降低上限並擴大管制範圍；Visa 2019 與歐委會和解的跨境交換費限制已延長至 2029。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: The European Commission has announced its intention to conduct another impact assessment of the IFR, which could result in even lower caps on interchange rates and the expansion of regulation to other types of products, services and fees.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 風險因素：Visa 受多項涉及競爭/反壟斷法的訴訟與調查，反壟斷集體訴訟可能涉及三倍賠償，詳見 Note 20。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 1A Risk Factors
findings.excerpt: We are subject to numerous litigation matters, investigations, claims, examinations, information gathering requests, subpoenas, government and regulatory proceedings asserted by civil litigants, governments and enforcement bodies investigating or alleging, among other things, violations of competition and antitrust law

regulatory_antitrust.note: DOJ 2024-09 於 SDNY 提起借記卡壟斷訴訟（Sherman Act 1/2），搜尋摘要稱仍進行中、未定審判日；搜尋結果日期不可靠，僅以 clue 保留。FTC 無 Visa 專案；第二條查詢被簽證類結果污染。

clues.claim: 加州北區法官駁回投資人就 DOJ 反壟斷訴訟指控 Visa 未揭露的集體訴訟；DOJ 借記卡壟斷案仍在進行
clues.source: Bloomberg Law: Visa Escapes Shareholder Class Suit Over DOJ Antitrust Complaint

clues.claim: DOJ 持續推進對 Visa 的反壟斷案
clues.source: Payments Dive: DOJ presses Visa antitrust case
